Removed 'shoulders' (Anterior Deltoids) from primary — it is a secondary mover in the push-up phase, not a prime mover. The defining 'plus' phase primarily works serratus anterior (no allowed bucket, cannot be mapped). Added 'mid back' (Upper Traps, Lower Traps) to secondary based on strong EMG evidence that trapezius is significantly active during the scapular protraction phase. Kept chest as sole primary. Note: serratus anterior (the key muscle of the plus phase) cannot be represented in the allowed muscle mapping and is therefore omitted — flagged for user awareness.

Added 'Triceps' (Triceps Brachii) as a primary muscle. This stretch (hand reaching up the back) is functionally an overhead triceps stretch — the triceps brachii long head is the primary muscle being lengthened. Posterior Deltoid gets a meaningful stretch and is retained as co-primary. Rotator cuff (infraspinatus/teres minor) remains as secondary. The previous data omitted the triceps entirely despite it being the main target of this stretch position.
